newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania suspends senior energy officials.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania suspends senior energy officials.

text.p: Eight senior officials of state-owned Tanzania Electric Supply Co Ltd (Tanesco) have been suspended over allegations they misused funds totalling 216 million shillings ($366,100).
Details of the suspensions, concerning electrification at the Ubungo power plant in the capital, were announced on Thursday by energy and minerals minister William Shija.

"The government is following up the Ubungo gas turbines issue and should it be proven that some people embezzled funds legal action will be taken against them," Shija said. He ordered Tanesco's board to report within three weeks on the issue.
Two of the eight are deputy managing directors of Tanesco, a third was the director for internal audits.
Earlier in the week a parliamentary committee released a report highly critical of finance minister Simon Mbilinyi, implicated in a multiple tax evasion scam.
President Benjamin Mkapa has set a crackdown on corruption as one his highest priorities.
